definition: Raia Hadsell is VP of Research at Google DeepMind and Inventor of Contrastive Loss / t-SNE precursors.
details: Co-invented Dimensionality Reduction by Learning an Invariant Mapping (Contrastive Loss / Siamese networks) and leads continual learning and robotics at DeepMind.

explainer.lead: Raia Hadsell is a computer scientist.
